title: Exposing Assumptions in AI Benchmarks through Cognitive Modelling

bias_targets.methodology: Using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) to evaluate latent variables for 'Cultural Knowledge' across different cultures by analyzing model performance on culture-specific tasks, such as the Danish citizenship test versus standard English reading comprehension datasets.

Constructing cognitive models to measure cross-lingual alignment transfer, specifically testing whether LLM alignment (e.g., being Harmless, Helpful, and Honest) transfers from English to other languages like Danish.
